blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse applied to Renewable Energy. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization. Margins live in availability percentage points and forecast accuracy — both telemetry problems.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Energy & Utilities level this capability reads as: metered energy/emissions with lineage to disclosure reports (audit-ready reporting on schedule). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
